rules.description: Light Aspects are passive powers created from the Character's Connection to the Light and activated by applying them to an Aspect Slot.

aspect_slots.installation: An empty Aspect Slot can install a single owned Light Aspect at a time.
aspect_slots.between_missions: Once a Character purchases a Light Aspect, they keep it and can freely switch it in and out of Aspect Slots between missions.

purchasing.connection_requirement: Each Light Aspect is listed under a Connection.
purchasing.different_connection_cost: When purchasing a Light Aspect from a different Connection, the Character must pay double the listed Experience Cost.
